items.event: DP World Tour Championship, Dubai (Race to Dubai finale)
items.line: Season finale at Jumeirah Golf Estates decides the Race to Dubai. Eugenio Chacarra leads Rory McIlroy by about 534 points with nine players still alive; 2,000 points go to the winner.
